## 🎙 PODCAST SCRIPT  
**Episode Title:** *Return to the Wild: The Arcana Resort Experience*  
**Guest:** Jeremy [Arcana Resort, Ontario]  
**Host:** Bethany Gifford  
**Duration:** ~35 minutes  

---

### 🎧 INTRO

Hi everyone and welcome back to *The Aesthetic & Wellness Edge*. I’m your host, **Bethany Gifford**, and today’s episode is truly special.  

If you’ve ever dreamed of escaping into nature, reconnecting with yourself, and experiencing wellness on a deeper level, you’re going to love this conversation.  

My guest today is **Jeremy**, co-founder of **Arcana**, a one-of-a-kind wellness resort in Ontario, Canada that blends modern architecture, nature immersion, and restorative design to help guests, as they put it, “return to the wild.”  

Arcana’s mission isn’t just about luxury travel. It’s about rediscovering the self that exists beyond society’s noise — through sound, space, water, stillness, and reflection.  

But first, a quick word from our sponsor.  

---

### 💡 WORD FROM OUR SPONSOR

This episode is brought to you by **New Era Intel**, the growth consultancy helping aesthetic and wellness brands scale smarter, automate client journeys, and stand out in competitive markets.  

To learn more, visit [www.neweraintel.com](https://www.neweraintel.com) or connect with me on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/bethany-gifford/).  

---

### 🎙 SEGMENT 1: THE ORIGIN STORY

Jeremy, I’m so glad you’re here. I have to start by saying — Arcana is visually stunning. The cabins, the setting, even the philosophy behind it feels different.  

Before we get into the design and wellness experience, I’d love to hear how this all began. How did Arcana come to life?  

You searched for years to find the right property, and when you finally discovered this 56-acre, 1,300-foot waterfront site outside Toronto, something clicked. It’s incredible to see how that vision evolved into this next-generation wellness destination.  

That kind of persistence and patience is something our listeners — many of whom are entrepreneurs — can really relate to. It’s a reminder that when something is aligned with purpose, the right opportunity always unfolds.  

---

### 🌿 SEGMENT 2: RETURN TO THE WILD

Let’s talk about the philosophy behind Arcana, because it’s powerful. You describe your mission as helping people “return to the wild.”  

That phrase isn’t just about nature — it’s about returning to the *self* beneath the noise, the version of us that existed before pressure, expectations, and comparison took over.  

I think that resonates with so many people, especially in the aesthetics and wellness world. We help people look and feel good, but often forget that true wellness begins with reconnecting to who we are inside.  

The concept of returning to the wild feels like a call to come home — not just physically, but emotionally.  

---

### 💧 SEGMENT 3: DESIGN AS THERAPY

One of the most striking parts of Arcana is its architecture. These cabins are minimalist, artistic, and deeply intentional.  

The partnership between you and architect **Michael Leckie** created something that goes far beyond design — it’s therapy through environment.  

Each cabin is positioned to foster stillness, solitude, and connection to the natural world. It’s a sanctuary where every element — the light, materials, and view — works to bring guests into harmony.  

And then there are the experiential spaces. The **Hydrotherapy Cabin**, right on the water, with sauna, tea lounge, cold plunge, hot tubs, and fire pits. It’s a sensory reset that reconnects body and mind through nature’s elements.  

And the **Sound Journey Room** — I absolutely love this concept. A multi-sensory experience using vibration, sound, and light to create a meditative, out-of-body calm. It’s an entirely new dimension of wellness.  

For guests who crave inner peace but don’t connect with traditional meditation, this opens a whole new doorway to mindfulness.  

---

### 🪷 SEGMENT 4: DEFINING WELLNESS DIFFERENTLY

You made a profound point that so many people haven’t yet defined what wellness truly means to them.  

And that’s so true. Wellness can’t be one-size-fits-all. It’s not just massages, diet, or exercise — it’s the freedom to explore what nourishes your soul.  

Arcana invites people into that exploration. It helps them slow down enough to hear their own thoughts again, to rest, to reflect, and to reconnect.  

And in doing so, they often redefine what fulfillment actually looks like.  

It’s such a refreshing approach to wellness — not about consumption or achievement, but curiosity, stillness, and simplicity.  

---

### 🌲 SEGMENT 5: THE FUTURE OF ARCANA

Arcana’s official opening is planned for the end of 2026, and I’m so excited to see how this unfolds.  

You’re converting the resort into a year-round experience with luxury cabins, immersive amenities, and meaningful retreats. And I love that it’s not just about creating another resort — it’s about building a movement around mindful travel and conscious living.  

The future of wellness tourism is personalization and purpose — and Arcana embodies both.  

As we approach that launch, I think people are going to be craving exactly this: something real, grounded, and transformative.  

This is more than a getaway. It’s a reconnection point — for individuals, couples, and communities ready to live with more clarity and intention.  

---

### ✨ CLOSING

Jeremy, thank you for joining me today and for sharing the vision behind Arcana.  

Your approach to wellness is not only inspiring, but also necessary in a world that moves too fast. You’re building something that helps people pause, reflect, and rediscover the wild within themselves.  

For everyone listening, make sure to follow **Arcana** on social media and keep an eye on their journey as they prepare for their 2026 launch.  

If you loved this episode, please take a moment to subscribe, share it with a friend, and leave a review. It helps others find these conversations about growth, health, and transformation.  

I’m your host, **Bethany Gifford**, and this has been another episode of *The Aesthetic & Wellness Edge*.  

Until next time — take care of yourself, stay curious, and never stop growing.  

---
